2.8 Comments, if any, from the Supervisor in the Host Institution
We are delighted to have had Mohamadou Siribie among us as full member of the Clinical
Development team and greatly appreciate his contribution to the various projects he is
involved in. Mohamadou Siribie has been very productive during his stay at IVI. We
particularly appreciate his passion for public health and his constructive comments during our
multiple interactions. We sincerely hope we can maintain and develop a long-term
collaboration with Mohamadou Siribie in Burkina-Faso.

2.9 Acknowledgements
I am thankful to:
-­‐ WHO-TDR and EDCTP for offering this great opportunity to young scientists from
Low- and Middle-Income Countries for their career development and the capacity
building of their home institution.
-­‐ IVI for offering me the opportunity to be hosted in the institution.
-­‐ My host supervisors, Dr. Laura Digilio and Dr. Jean-Louis Excler, for their warm
welcome and their availabilities. I am learning a lot from their great experience.

- IVI’s Clinical Development and Regulatory Team, the IVI’s Epidemiology Team and
the Project Management Team for offering me a great working and supportive
learning environment as well as for sharing the warm atmosphere and personal
exchanges all along this year.
-­‐ My home supervisor: Dr. Sodiomon Bienvenu Sirima for giving me the opportunity to
pursue my dream of becoming a scientist and for his continuing support.

3. Appendix

3.1 Appendix 1: Travels supported by the International Vaccine Institute
-­‐ Three round trips Seoul – Dhaka – Seoul and the accommodation fees have been
supported by the International Vaccine Institute for the trial monitoring purpose and
the visit of the plant of Incepta Pharmaceuticals in Bangladesh.
-­‐ One round trip Seoul – Accra and Ouagadougou - Seoul and accommodation was
supported the International Vaccine Institute to attend and facilitate the joint workshop
co-organized by IVI, the University of Bielefeld and the University of Legon on the
infectious diseases epidemiology at the University of Legon, Accra, Ghana. This trip
gave me the opportunity to visit my family in Burkina four month after the start of the
fellowship programme.

3.2 Appendix 2: Training fees supported by the International Vaccine Institute
-­‐ My attendance to the International Vaccinology Course has been supported by IVI
(Approximate cost = US $ 2,500).
